title: Design System: Booking Buddy
notes: No shipping raster assets. The cork ground is inline SVG fractal-noise data-URIs in globals.css; all pins, tape, cards, stamps and holes are CSS. Two throwaway HTML concept mockups (board + sign-up sheet) were the only visual references and are not shipping assets. Scope is the `.bb-theme` world only.

pin-commit.note: Locked brand orange; never darkened (PRODUCT.md). Rationed to one pushpin per screen.

notice.purpose: Anton screen-print voice: page titles, landing headlines, section headings. Uppercase, tracked, line-height <1.

label.purpose: Anton small-caps for masking-tape labels, venue tags, nav labels, card date stamps, the status key, stamps.

title.purpose: Libre Franklin 600 for a running title like a GameCard game time. NOT Anton.

body.purpose: Libre Franklin 400 for all read information, forms, help text. Max ~65ch.

hand.purpose: Caveat 700 for handwritten marks only: RSVP tallies, 'no court yet', short notes. Never a label or body or button.

shadows.name: contact-shadow
shadows.purpose: The house shadow. Every .bb-card, .bb-sheet and dialog — stock resting a few mm off the wall.

shadows.name: card-hover-lift
shadows.purpose: Interactive whole-card links on hover, paired with translateY(-2px) scale(1.008), 150ms.

shadows.name: pushpin
shadows.purpose: The enamel pin disc — one cast shadow, one inset. Matte, not glossy.

shadows.name: routed-sign
shadows.purpose: Desktop nav only — bevel that makes it a hung physical sign.

shadows.name: tape
shadows.purpose: Low soft strip shadow under masking tape.

motion.name: pin-drop
motion.purpose: The signature entrance. Card drops translateY(-9px)->1px->0, rotates to resting tilt, shadow lands. Decelerate, deliberately NO spring. bb-pin-drop keyframe.

motion.name: board-load-stagger
motion.purpose: The dashboard's one orchestrated page-load: cards pin themselves on in reading order, then the board stills. html.js + prefers-reduced-motion:no-preference gated.

motion.name: flap-on-update
motion.purpose: A changed value turns over old->new in place (rotateX). Scaffolding for CHANGED-SINCE-SEEN; not yet wired to behavior.

motion.name: card-interactive
motion.purpose: Whole-card link hover lift / 90ms active press.

motion.name: rsvp-pin-press
motion.purpose: The RSVP pin sinks (translateY(2px) scale(0.9)) as it is pushed in.

radii.name: card
radii.purpose: --radius; near-square index-card corner for all kraft cards.

radii.name: taped
radii.purpose: Regions, dialogs, status key, empty-state outline.

radii.name: pill
radii.purpose: Enamel pins, capacity holes, nav underline only.

components.name: Commit Button
components.description: The one decisive action per screen — carries a literal orange commit pushpin at its top edge.
components.css: .ds-btn-commit { position: relative; height: 3rem; padding: 0 1.75rem; border: none; border-radius: 0.28rem; background: #f26522; color: oklch(0.955 0.024 83); font-family: Anton, 'Arial Narrow', sans-serif; text-transform: uppercase; letter-spacing: 0.13em; font-size: 0.85rem; box-shadow: 0 2px 4px oklch(0.32 0.04 45 / 0.32), 0 16px 30px -12px oklch(0.36 0.06 40 / 0.5); transition: transform 150ms cubic-bezier(0.32,0.72,0,1); } .ds-btn-commit:hover { transform: translateY(-2px); } .ds-btn-commit:active { transform: translateY(0); } .ds-btn-commit:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #f26522; outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-btn-commit__pin { position: absolute; top: -0.5rem; left: 50%; width: 1.05rem; height: 1.05rem; margin-left: -0.525rem; border-radius: 50%; background: radial-gradient(circle at 34% 30%, oklch(1 0 0 / 0.55), transparent 44%), radial-gradient(circle at 62% 74%, oklch(0 0 0 / 0.22), transparent 55%), #f26522; box-shadow: 0 2px 3px oklch(0.2 0.03 40 / 0.5), inset 0 -1px 2px oklch(0 0 0 / 0.25); } @media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) { .ds-btn-commit { transition: none; } .ds-btn-commit:hover { transform: none; } }

components.name: Ghost Button
components.description: Secondary action — thin board-edge outline, no fill, no pin.
components.css: .ds-btn-ghost { height: 3rem; padding: 0 1.5rem; border: 1px solid oklch(0.44 0.05 52 / 0.25); border-radius: 0.28rem; background: transparent; color: oklch(0.23 0.022 52); font-family: Anton, 'Arial Narrow', sans-serif; text-transform: uppercase; letter-spacing: 0.13em; font-size: 0.8rem; transition: background 150ms ease; } .ds-btn-ghost:hover { background: oklch(0.23 0.022 52 / 0.05); } .ds-btn-ghost:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #f26522; outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Pushpin
components.description: The status law made physical — a matte enamel disc pinned at the top edge of a card. Colour = status (in/need/maybe/info/commit).
components.css: .ds-pushpin { display: inline-block; width: 1.05rem; height: 1.05rem; border-radius: 50%; --pin: oklch(0.52 0.15 256); background: radial-gradient(circle at 34% 30%, oklch(1 0 0 / 0.55), transparent 44%), radial-gradient(circle at 62% 74%, oklch(0 0 0 / 0.22), transparent 55%), var(--pin); box-shadow: 0 2px 3px oklch(0.2 0.03 40 / 0.5), inset 0 -1px 2px oklch(0 0 0 / 0.25); } .ds-pushpin--in { --pin: oklch(0.6 0.14 152); } .ds-pushpin--need { --pin: oklch(0.57 0.2 28); } .ds-pushpin--maybe { --pin: oklch(0.76 0.15 78); } .ds-pushpin--info { --pin: oklch(0.52 0.15 256); } .ds-pushpin--commit { --pin: #f26522; }

narrative.overview:
Booking Buddy is the cork board on the wall of a community pickleball hall, kept tidy by someone who cares. Every game is a real piece of kraft or index-card stock pinned up with one enamel pushpin, sitting at a slight opt-in angle over a warm contact shadow. You read the board across the room: the soonest game is the biggest card, a masking-tape strip names each area, and four pin colours carry a fixed status law so a first-timer can decode the wall without instruction. The build refuses the Calendly dashboard - no grid-plus-sidebar, no equal-weight panel matrix. The one grid the world keeps (the week/month calendar, any dense list) is redrawn as a laminated sign-up sheet pinned to that same board, ruled in pencil.

The palette is entirely warm and physical: red-brown cork ground, kraft paper, forest-green routed signage, ballpoint blue and graphite for handwriting. Brand orange (#f26522, locked and never darkened) is rationed to exactly one commit pin per screen. Type is three faces with hard-walled jobs: Anton screen-prints every notice, tape label and stamp; Libre Franklin does all headings, body, UI and table data; Caveat is pen marks only.

Motion is one idea: pinning. A card arriving drops a few pixels, rotates to its resting angle and lands its shadow - a decelerate, deliberately no spring. The dashboard plays this once as an orchestrated board-load, then stills; every other surface cuts to rest. Reduced motion and no-JS get the board already pinned up.
keyCharacteristics: Cork ground, kraft cards, one real pushpin, warm offset contact shadow - never a flat halo
Near-square corners (0.28rem); rotation is opt-in, and the status key never tilts
Four-colour pin law (green in / red needs-you / amber maybe / cobalt info) + one orange commit pin
Three faces, walled: Anton = notice, Libre Franklin = workhorse, Caveat = handwriting only
The only grid is a pinned laminated sign-up sheet, pencil-ruled
One motion: the pin-drop; one orchestrated sequence, on the dashboard only

rules.name: The One Commit Pin Rule
rules.body: Brand orange appears exactly once per screen, as the pushpin on the single most important action. If a second orange element wants in, one of them is not the commit - demote it to ink (bg-foreground) or a pin-law colour. Duration pickers and view toggles use ink, never orange.

rules.name: The Pin Law Rule
rules.body: The four pin colours mean exactly in / needs-you / maybe / info and nothing else, everywhere. The legend that teaches them (StatusKey) has exactly four entries and never tilts. Orange is an action cue, not a fifth law entry - it never appears in the key.

rules.name: The Dark Mode Is Dormant Rule
rules.body: A .dark .bb-theme token set exists but nothing ever activates it (no toggle, no prefers-color-scheme sync). Treat the light cork world as the only shipped surface; don't build against the dark tokens.

rules.name: The Three Faces, Walled Rule
rules.body: Anton = notices, tape labels, stamps, big numerals. Libre Franklin = everything read as information (headings, body, UI, table data). Caveat = handwritten content only - a tally, a FULL, a scribbled note - never a label, never body copy, never a button. Geist never appears in this world.

rules.name: The No Eyebrow Rule
rules.body: Page headings carry no kicker/eyebrow - the routed nav sign already names the section. A short uppercase Anton line above a card title is allowed only as a literal date stamp (the day of a game), not as a category label.

rules.name: The Contact-Not-Halo Rule
rules.body: Every shadow has vertical offset and a warm brown tint. A zero-offset even glow is forbidden - it breaks the pinned-to-a-wall read. Depth = one object resting near another, never a floating card.

dos: Do stand every signed-in surface on .bb-board cork and put content on kraft .bb-cards or one .bb-sheet.
Do give each card exactly one pushpin whose colour states its status per the four-colour law.
Do spend the single orange commit pin on the one action that matters on that screen; make everything else ink or a law colour.
Do lead a region with its most urgent/soonest item, largest - reading order is the layout.
Do keep Anton for notices/labels/stamps, Libre Franklin for all read information, Caveat for handwritten marks only.
Do cast the warm two-part contact shadow (--bb-contact-shadow) on anything pinned up.
Do render the calendar and dense lists as a pencil-ruled laminated sign-up sheet, pinned, unrotated.
Do use near-square corners (0.28rem cards, 3-4px sheets/taped things) and the opt-in -1.1deg-family tilt on posted cards only.
Do keep the pin-drop as the only entrance motion - a decelerate with no spring - and only orchestrate it once, on the dashboard; reduced motion gets everything at rest.
donts: Don't build a Calendly grid-plus-sidebar or an equal-weight panel matrix - this world is a board, not a dashboard.
Don't darken or recolour brand orange #f26522, and don't let a second orange element onto a screen.
Don't add a fifth pin colour or reassign one of the four meanings; don't tilt the status key or the sign-up sheet.
Don't use a zero-offset even glow or a Material elevation ramp - every shadow is offset and warm-tinted.
Don't set body copy, labels or buttons in Caveat, and don't bring Geist into .bb-theme.
Don't put a kicker/eyebrow above a page or section heading (a literal date stamp on a card is the only exception).
Don't add spring physics, parallax, or a second authored page-load sequence - Operate-mode restraint holds outside the one board-load.
